active_ms.operational_definition: Provider-side active compute milliseconds for the attempt.

available_cost.operational_definition: Per-attempt monetary cost or cost budget exposed by the provider.

available_tokens.operational_definition: Per-attempt token budget or token consumption exposed by the provider.

checkpoint_count.operational_definition: attempt.checkpoint_seq in the observed committed result document.

collision_count.operational_definition: Number of other counted units whose registered owned_paths prefix-overlap this unit's owned_paths.

context_sha256.operational_definition: sha256 over the concatenated frozen context bundle: capsule input.json bytes, acceptance.json bytes, metric-definitions.json bytes, criteria-freeze.json bytes.

defect_count.durable_source: computed by this harness from observed committed bytes
defect_count.operational_definition: Number of durable verification defects this harness observed for the unit: artifact read-back mismatches, unreadable artifact locators, result-contract violations and manifest/result disagreements.

exact_model.operational_definition: runtime.exact_model recorded in the immutable task capsule.

first_pass_outcome.operational_definition: verdict recorded in the observed artifact manifest for attempt 1.

founder_action_count.operational_definition: Hash-chained events for the unit whose actor is a founder or owner.

function.operational_definition: function recorded in the immutable task capsule.

independent_disposition.operational_definition: independent_acceptance.state in the observed committed result document.

parent_id.operational_definition: controller_run_id recorded in the immutable task capsule.

prompt_sha256.operational_definition: sha256 of the UTF-8 bytes of task_prompt in the immutable capsule.

provider_block.operational_definition: Provider-block states present in the unit's hash-chained event log (FAILED_TERMINAL, CANCELLED, PROVIDER_COMPLETED_UNCOMMITTED), or NONE_OBSERVED.

queue_ms.operational_definition: Milliseconds between dispatch enqueue and provider start.

readback_state.operational_definition: Outcome of this harness reading every artifact of the observed result back by Git object id and comparing sha256 and byte count: VERIFIED, MISMATCH, UNREADABLE or NO_RESULT_OBSERVED.

reasoning.operational_definition: runtime.reasoning_control recorded in the immutable task capsule.

recovery_events.operational_definition: Hash-chained events for the unit in state RECOVERY_REQUIRED or RETRY_SCHEDULED.

result_commit_id.operational_definition: result_transaction.result_commit_id in the observed committed result document.

retry_count.operational_definition: transaction.attempt_number minus one, from the immutable capsule.

review_ms.operational_definition: Milliseconds an independent non-producer reviewer spent on the unit.

rework_count.operational_definition: Distinct attempts observed for the unit minus one, counted from capsule attempt_number and any INGESTION registry lines for the unit.

runtime.operational_definition: runtime.route recorded in the immutable task capsule.

source_sha256.operational_definition: sha256 of workstreams/po03/evidence/source-lock.json read by Git object id at the capsule's controller_head_sha.

task_id.operational_definition: The counted unit's task id as recorded by the CREATED registry line.

wall_ms.durable_source: git commit committer timestamp of the observed result_commit_id
wall_ms.operational_definition: Durable-custody wall interval in milliseconds: committer timestamp of the observed artifact commit minus the capsule created_at timestamp. This is a custody interval measured from Git and capsule bytes, not provider active time.
